manualSourceReview.finding: Stroke fence accepts one active ticket by identity. current checks projectEpoch, revision, exact mesh identity, unit and confirmed-unit state. finish(oldTicket) cannot finish a newer ticket. cancel invalidates synchronously; missing mesh/unconfirmed units cannot begin.

Source refs and project epoch are used instead of stale render captures. Recording cancellation precedes workspace publication, mesh replacement, guardReplacement, Undo, task cancellation and new project/install. Case-side updates journal a revision and synchronously cancel recording. Physical-unit changes are source-fenced; unit selector is disabled after confirmation and Undo revocation cancels before restoring unit state.

Fence checked at pointer-up, run entry, after asynchronous scheduling immediately before Worker dispatch, and in publication closure after Worker resolution. Task gate separately excludes concurrent tasks and rejects cancelled task commits. Recording path only appends copied points, never edits positions, RGB, baseline or undo history. No-op stroke does not append history/revision.

Move/up/cancel events are scoped to active pointerId. On pointer-up local sculpting/pointerId are cleared before native capture release and onStrokeEnd, so ensuing lostpointercapture cannot cancel pending publication. Cancellation invalidates App transaction before releasing capture; controls are re-enabled. Mesh/brush changes, capture loss, pointercancel, blur and cleanup use cancellation rather than completion. Stale non-active-pointer events are ignored; no deferred old-stroke publication callback exists in Viewport.

Brush entry remains gated by outward-normal audit and confirmed units. The review does not convert quality UNKNOWN into PASS and does not confer clinical validation. Narrow static scan of the three production files found no hardcoded credential assignment, eval/exec or HTTP(S) literal.
